content:
Delighted to receive this Certificate of Participation for attending the webinar "Can AI Decide Disputes Without Killing Due Process?" organized by Law Jurist.
The session provided valuable insights into the evolving role of Artificial Intelligence in the legal system, while emphasizing the importance of fairness, transparency, and due process.
Grateful to Prof. Anjali Chawla and the organizers for sharing their expertise. Looking forward to exploring more at the intersection of law and technology.

comment: The real test for AI in dispute resolution will be less about speed and more about ensuring explainability, accountability, and meaningful human oversight when decisions affect rights and remedies.
